close_reason: Replaced near-duplicate keywords (sct, ct) with pki and rfc6962 for better crates.io discoverability.
description:
pkix-ct/Cargo.toml:10:
  keywords = ["x509", "certificate", "transparency", "sct", "ct"]

5 keywords (the crates.io maximum), and three of them refer to the same thing: 'transparency', 'sct', 'ct'. crates.io search rewards distinctness — picking 'transparency' OR 'ct' (not both) frees a slot for, e.g., 'rfc6962' or 'pki', which are the keywords used by pkix-path and pkix-chain for cross-crate discoverability.

Suggested replacement:
  keywords = ["x509", "certificate", "pki", "transparency", "rfc6962"]

Severity: P4 / opinion. Trivial fix; no functional impact.

Pass-1 attribution: pass 1 added Cargo metadata (PKIX-6xdl) for pkix-lint but did not audit the existing stub-crate metadata.
title: P4: pkix-ct keywords contain a near-duplicate ('ct' and 'transparency' and 'sct')
